name: Igor Pankin
headline: Technical Leader & Agent-Driven Development Pioneer
tagline: I build intelligent systems that automate workflows, orchestrate microservices, and bridge the gap between business needs and technical excellence.

experience.description: Architecting and building autonomous agent systems that orchestrate complex workflows across messaging, scheduling, data pipelines, and third-party APIs. Focused on creating maintainable, scalable solutions with measurable business impact.
highlights: Designed and deployed omb-agent — a multi-agent orchestration platform using AutoGen, CrewAI, n8n, and Dify
Built tg-scheduler — a Telegram-based scheduling and automation system integrated with Google services
Created a Garmin-to-Google Sheets pipeline for automated fitness data aggregation
Developed and maintained Docker-based infrastructure-as-code environments for rapid prototyping

experience.description: Experienced in software engineering, system architecture, and team leadership across multiple domains including fintech, e-commerce, and SaaS platforms.
highlights: Led development teams delivering measurable business outcomes
Designed and implemented scalable backend architectures
Established CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
Mentored junior developers and contributed to engineering culture

achievements.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Platform
achievements.description: Built omb-agent — a platform orchestrating AI agents via AutoGen and CrewAI, connected to n8n, Dify, and Telegram. Achieved full end-to-end automation of complex multi-step workflows.

achievements.title: Infrastructure-as-Code Environment
achievements.description: Designed and maintains a complete IaC dev environment with Docker Compose stacks for PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, Traefik, Watchtower, and multiple application services — all version-controlled and reproducible.

achievements.title: Telegram Bot Automation
achievements.description: Developed a Telegram-based scheduler and notification system that bridges messaging with Google Calendar, Google Sheets, and custom data pipelines — running reliably in production.

achievements.title: Fitness Data Pipeline
achievements.description: Built garmin2googlesheet — an automated pipeline extracting fitness metrics from Garmin Connect and syncing them to structured Google Sheets for analysis and visualization.
